title: Keeping cached summaries honest
understanding: Changed length is a weak guide to staleness; see [[summary-drift-notes]]. Hashing only the sections a summary cites looks cheap and has not been tried on real pages. Regenerating on every save is the safe default but costs more than it needs to; see [[regeneration-cost-notes]].
